description: This file defines the 'SingleWaiterAutoResetEvent' class implementing a custom synchronization primitive for use within the Orleans runtime, supporting signaling and waiting mechanisms for a single waiter context.

classes.name: SingleWaiterAutoResetEvent
classes.description: An internal sealed class representing an auto-reset event allowing a single waiter, with support for concurrent signalers.

methods.name: Signal
methods.description: Signals the event, waking up the waiter if present.

methods.name: WaitAsync
methods.description: Returns a ValueTask that completes when the event is signaled.

methods.name: ResetStatus
methods.description: Resets the internal status flags after a wait completes.
